proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal – 3rd Edition (2026)
proposals.why: Most recent global independent scientific assessment of CDR status, costs, potentials, and role in net zero.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal – 2nd Edition (2024)
proposals.why: Expanded global CDR assessment covering deployment, governance, and gap to net-zero scenarios.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report (AR6 SYR)
proposals.why: Authoritative IPCC synthesis stating CDR is necessary for net-negative CO₂ and net-zero GHG emissions.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change – Chapter 12: Cross-sectoral Perspectives (AR6 WGIII)
proposals.why: Definitive IPCC chapter assessing CDR methods, potentials, costs, and role in net-zero mitigation portfolios.

proposals.title: The carbon dioxide removal gap
proposals.why: Quantifies gap between national CDR proposals and 1.5 °C-consistent scenarios; key policy-relevant analysis.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 1: Research landscape and synthesis
proposals.why: Foundational systematic review of the full NETs/CDR literature, ethics, and role in climate scenarios.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 2: Costs, potentials and side effects
proposals.why: Systematic review of costs, removal potentials, and co-benefits/risks of individual CDR methods.

proposals.title: Negative Emissions Technologies and Reliable Sequestration: A Research Agenda
proposals.first_author: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
proposals.why: Comprehensive US national academies consensus report assessing NETs benefits, risks, scale potential, and research needs.
